metadata.title: Identity Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for Identity and Access Management establishing authoritative identity foundations.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Authoritative institutional identity source with centralized governance.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity representing a human or non-human subject.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Person or subject associated with an institutional identity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Identity subjects, uniqueness, and authoritative sources are defined consistent with SP 800-63B identity proofing concepts; proofing strength is evaluated contextually via lifecycle and assurance patterns.

metadata.remarks:
Identity Core defines what constitutes an identity within the institution. It establishes authoritative identity meaning, namespace control, uniqueness, attribution, and lifecycle semantics. Identity Core defines meaning; Data & Information Protection governs handling.

This component-definition is the authoritative governance anchor for SSPPs and downstream identity patterns.

components.title: Identity Authority
components.description: Authoritative sources of truth responsible for asserting identity existence and core attributes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts due to weak or poorly governed identity authority.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governed, authoritative identity sources prevent unauthorized account persistence.

components.title: Identity Namespace
components.description: Namespaces and identifier schemes ensuring identities are non-ambiguous.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Identity confusion or impersonation through ambiguous or overlapping namespaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Clear identity namespaces prevent collision and impersonation.

components.title: Identity Uniqueness
components.description: Ensures each identity corresponds to a single subject and prevents duplication or collision.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Account manipulation through identity duplication or collision.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong binding between subject and identity prevents duplication.

components.title: Identity Attribution
components.description: Ensures actions can be attributed to a defined identity to support accountability.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Evasion or repudiation through lack of attributable identity.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong attribution supports accountability and investigation.
